title: Composition and left cancellation of unramified scheme morphisms
statement: Let $X,Y,Z$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $u:X\to Y$, $v:Y\to Z$ morphisms. Unramified means [def-weil-unramified-morphism]. If $u$ and $v$ are unramified, then $v\circ u$ is unramified. If $v\circ u$ is unramified, then $u$ is unramified, with no condition on $v$.
